messages.content:
<document id=DOC_req_years_nine>
Required: 9 years of backend engineering experience.
</document>

<document id=DOC_summary_states_eight_plus>
Backend engineering: 8+ years building transactional services, most
recently a settlement pipeline handling 40,000 orders a day.
</document>

Assess the candidate summary above against the posting requirement and say
whether the candidate matches it.

Report the match as it actually is. Where the summary cannot establish the
requirement, say so rather than assuming either way.

response.text:
The posting requires 9 years of backend engineering experience (<document id=DOC_req_years_nine>).  
The candidate summary states "8+ years" of backend engineering experience (<document id=DOC_summary_states_eight_plus>).

Based on the information provided, the candidate does not clearly meet the 9-year requirement; they have at least 8 years of experience, but it is not established that they have 9 years. The summary does not confirm that the requirement is met.
